model: One scalar nuisance coordinate z is shared by modulus and density AND all candidates. Each candidate has E(z)=intercept+slope*z,rho(z)=intercept+slope*z as recorded. The full joint uncertainty set is exactly this one-dimensional interval,not the Cartesian box of separate marginal ranges. Specific modulus is E/rho in GPa*cm^3/g;all listed densities are strictly positive. Robust choice maximizes each candidate minimum E/rho over the full interval.
dominance_definition: Ordered pair[X,Y]means E_X(z)/rho_X(z)>=E_Y(z)/rho_Y(z)for every admissible COMMON z,with strict inequality at least once. Report all such ordered pairs,without duplicates or self-pairs.
box_shortcut: For each candidate independently minimize its E marginal and maximize its rho marginal,divide those two extrema,then choose the highest resulting lower bound. This intentionally ignores within-candidate correlation.
target: Return the sharp joint-model worst specific modulus for each candidate in source order,the robust chosen ID,all uniform dominance pairs,the three box-shortcut values and its chosen ID,and whether that shortcut preserves the robust choice.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled conditional material model;not a measured material claim.
